axes.label: reaction of the cast and objects around her

identity_anchors.description: deep-blue hair mass with cyan curled ends

cues: blank white eyes or dot eyes
a face-only gekiga rendering with heavy hatching
manga_burst.guard: Deform only the face or body silhouette. Keep the rest of the canvas in the frozen style, and keep at least three identity anchors clearly visible.

A.label: manga impact
A.summary: Full Japanese-manga impact: a detailed scene, a bold camera, effect lines, manga_burst faces, stylized lettering and a world that reacts.

axes.camera: extreme low or high angle, fisheye, extreme close-up or diagonal composition; a full frame
axes.background: detailed location scene with perspective and props; every sign, screen, page and label surface is blank or turned away
axes.lighting: high value contrast or backlight; local black-and-white or screentone allowed
axes.effect_lines: concentration lines, speed lines, a black-and-white impact flash or a collapsing background
axes.body_action: squash and stretch, afterimages, flying out of frame, sudden chibi shift or petrification
axes.manpu: large manpu marks with no count limit, each tied to the beat
axes.balloons: burst balloons, oversized hand-lettered lines, stacked exclamation marks
axes.sfx: at most two drawn sound effects of at most four characters each
axes.world_reaction: partners blown back or petrified; objects shatter or fly

markers.text: A recognizable location with perspective and props fills the landing panel, with no readable writing on any surface.
Concentration lines, speed lines or an impact flash frame the landing beat.
Whale-chan's landing face reaches manga_burst deformation.
A burst balloon, an oversized hand-lettered line or a drawn sound effect delivers the landing text.

A.default_background: detailed text-free location scene with perspective and props
forbidden: a style shift beyond the face
readable or pseudo writing on scene surfaces
more than two drawn sound effects or one longer than four characters

B.label: comic outburst
B.summary: A clear comic outburst: desk-slamming accusations, situations getting out of hand, comic collapse.

axes.camera: normal camera height with a possible tilt
axes.background: effect background (speed lines, concentration lines, flat burst color or screentone) or a simplified scene
axes.lighting: normal palette with an accent color
axes.effect_lines: local motion lines, vibration lines, sparse concentration lines
axes.body_action: slamming the desk, pointing, charging, clutching the head
axes.manpu: manpu within each expression preset's limits
axes.sfx: at most one drawn sound effect of at most four characters
axes.world_reaction: partners recoil or point back; objects tip over

markers.text: A large readable body action: slamming the desk, pointing, charging, clutching the head or a comic collapse.
At least one motion line, vibration line or manpu mark punctuates the beat.

B.default_background: comic effect background of speed lines, concentration lines, a flat burst color or screentone
forbidden: manga_burst deformation or a gekiga face
an impact flash or collapsing background
partners blown away or petrified, or objects shattering
more than one drawn sound effect

C.label: restrained deadpan
C.summary: Restrained or moderate delivery: gentle, dry, bittersweet, or carried by a sharp line.

axes.camera: eye level, centered, generous negative space
axes.background: pure white or a minimal setting
axes.effect_lines: none, or one or two lines at most
axes.balloons: plain round balloons, small lettering, captions, ellipses
axes.world_reaction: partners freeze or the room goes quiet; objects stay put

markers.text: Nothing on any axis exceeds the C palette.
Whale-chan's face stays at grounded or heightened.
The laugh is carried by the line, a glance or held negative space.
